steps.body: Two groups can be joined in either order. Three joined with eight makes the same total as eight joined with three, because the same counters are in the pile either way.
steps.narration: Two groups can be joined in either order. Three joined with eight makes the same total as eight joined with three, because the same counters are in the pile either way.

widget.prompt: Add 3 + 8 the fast way: start at 8 and count on 3. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 8 and count on 3: you land on 11.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 11 — swapping to start at 8 gave the same total with fewer hops.

predict.prompt: 3 + 8 is swapped to 8 + 3. Does the total change?
predict.reveal: The same two groups are joined either way, so the total cannot change.

options.label: 8 — the same total
options.feedback: Correct — swapping the order of the addends never changes the total; both give 8.

options.label: 9 — one more
options.feedback: Nothing was added when the order swapped, so the total cannot grow to 9.

options.label: 7 — one less
options.feedback: Nothing was removed when the order swapped, so the total cannot shrink to 7.

options.label: 2 — the difference
options.feedback: The difference compares the addends; swapping them is still addition and keeps the total 8.
